Tooele photographer exchanges photo sessions for food bank donations
summary: Wild Sage and Smoke, a Tooele-based photography studio, will hold a photo shoot at the New Life Church in Tooele on Saturday. The cost? Six non-perishable food items per person, donated to the church.

title: Tooele High School students turn art into community support tonight
summary: Around 300 students are using their artwork and handmade pottery to raise money and collect donations for local families through Tooele High School's annual Hot Soup, Warm Hearts event.

title: Data shows Utah drivers struggle during first snow storms of the year
summary: How much do Utah drivers struggle on the roads during the first snowstorms of the year? The Utah Highway Safety Office told KSL that this results in hundreds of crashes, and this year is no exception.

title: 1 in critical condition after semis crash on US-40
summary: A person was in critical condition on Friday after two semitrucks crashed on U.S. Route 40 in Wasatch County, according to the Utah Highway Patrol.

title: Federal agency blasts plans, now abandoned, to convert warehouses to ICE detention centers
summary: A federal watchdog agency is blasting the now-abandoned plans to convert warehouses in Salt Lake and other cities into ICE detention centers from a financial perspective.
